title: Edit a Presentation
page_title: Editing Presentations ICT - IGCSE Revision Notes

blocks.text: How do you edit a presentation?

blocks.md:
- Editing a presentation will depend on the **audience and purpose  **of the presentation
- Common editing techniques include:

blocks.text: Inserting, moving, deleting slides & applying slide layouts

blocks.md: - Using the **home tab**, in the '**slides**' section

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide titled "Base Metal Mining." The left sidebar shows four additional slides on Copper, Zinc, Tin, and Iron Ore Mining. The main slide lists "Around the world."
blocks.caption: Adding, moving & deleting slides in a presentation

blocks.md:
- Using the **insert tab** the user can choose to add:

  - **Images**
  - **Videos**
  - **Charts etc**.

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide titled "Tin Mining" with bullet points on dominance by China and Indonesia, 70% global output, depletion in 20-40 years, and rising prices in 10 years.
blocks.caption: Inserting objects in to a presentation

blocks.md:
- Presenter notes can be added to slides as** prompts for the presenter **for when **delivering** a presentation
- Presenter notes usually contain** key talking points**
- Using the **view tab**, in the '**Show**' section, select **Notes**

blocks.alt: PowerPoint presentation with the main slide titled "Base Metal Mining." The slide has a bullet point saying "Around the world." The sidebar shows four additional slides.
blocks.caption: Adding presenter notes to a presentation

blocks.md:
- Hyperlinks can be **added to text or objects** (images/videos etc.)
- **Select **the text or object
- Using the** insert tab**, select **Link**

blocks.alt: PowerPoint presentation titled "Base Metal Mining" with five slides listed on the left. The main slide reads "Base Metal Mining" and "Around the world."
blocks.caption: Adding hyperlinks in a presentation

blocks.md:
- An action button is **a clickable object that enhances the interactivity** of a presentation
- Common actions include:

  - **Navigation**
  - **Media playback**
  - **Run programs**
  - **Open links**

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide titled "Copper Mining" with bullet points about Escondida mine in Chile: largest mine, opened in 1988, 3.9 km long, 2.7 km wide, 645 m deep, 2013 output 1.1 Mt, 54-year reserve life.
blocks.caption: Using action buttons in a presentation

blocks.md:
- Screen tips are **short explanatory text** that appear when you** hover over an element** on the slide
- Screen tips provide **additional details** on hover

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide titled "Zinc Mining" with text about Rampura Agucha in India and a photo of an expansive open-pit mine. The slide is part of a presentation on basic metal mining.
blocks.caption: Using screen tips in a presentation

blocks.md:
- Alternative text **describes an image**
- Alt text is used for:

  - **Accessibility **- screen readers
  - To **understand the content** of an image

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide about zinc mining with text detailing India's largest zinc mine and global zinc statistics. Image shows an open-pit mining site.
blocks.caption: Adding alt text to images in a presentation

blocks.md:
- Transitions can be used when **moving between slides** to create a more visual appealing flow
- Animations can be used to** add movement or emphasis** to elements **on a slide**

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide about zinc mining featuring text on the left and an open-pit mine image on the right, highlighting Rampura Agucha in India.
blocks.caption: Adding transitions & animations to a presentation

blocks.md: - To hide a slide from a presentation without deleting, **right click on a slide** and select '**Hide Slide**'

blocks.alt: A PowerPoint presentation titled "Base Metal Mining" is open in edit mode, showing the title slide. The slide selection pane lists other slides related to mining types.
blocks.caption: Hiding slides in a presentation
